entries.name: 문지기
entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: individual 2D creature pawn body sprite for the Korean survival game '이웃 아닌'. Create ONE original creature only, full body, large native resolution preferably 1536x2048 or maximum available; generous 8 percent clear margin, nothing cropped. Style: extremely simplified hand-painted dark paper-cutout boardgame pawn; near-black charcoal masses, muted dark teal-grey brush planes, subtly irregular handmade paper edge with a very thin desaturated warm grey outline. Flat matte gouache/paper texture, 3 to 5 broad tonal shapes, readable at 120 pixels high. NOT photorealistic, NOT detailed fantasy concept painting, NOT shiny 3D, NOT cute cartoon. Three-quarter front view with slight view of upper surfaces suitable for existing top-ish view game. Soft upper-left shading, no dramatic cinematic lighting. TRUE transparent RGBA background, no checkerboard drawn, no background scene, no floor, no ground shadow, no circular base/pedestal (added independently in Unity), no text, no labels, no UI, no signature. Restrained uncanny abandoned-city anomaly, no blood or gore, no bright eyes. Each limb tip and outline must be entirely visible. Subject: A massive hunched porter fused with a battered apartment door standing vertically across its back, blank peephole positioned above its head, short thick legs, one long dangling arm. Silhouette broad rectangular tower. No weapon.
